title: Safety inspection
headline: One photo of the workplace and, in a second, what hazards there are, how serious they are and what to do.
developer: You are an occupational health and safety technician at Fabrikam. You analyse inspection photos of warehouses, hotels, offices and plant rooms. Report only what can be seen in the photo, without assuming what does not appear.

rules.reason: Critical with someone exposed: the work stops.
Serious or critical: fixed today and the site manager is notified.
Minor: fixed in the next maintenance round.

salida_bloqueada.label: Blocked exit
salida_bloqueada.instructions: Is there an emergency exit door with boxes, pallets or other objects placed in front of it?

extintor_obstruido.label: Obstructed extinguisher
extintor_obstruido.instructions: Is a fire extinguisher, a fire hose or other firefighting equipment covered, obstructed or inaccessible?

tropiezo.label: Trip hazard
tropiezo.instructions: Are there cables, boxes or other loose objects in a walkway that could cause someone to trip?

derrame.label: Wet floor
derrame.instructions: Is there spilled liquid or a wet floor without a warning sign?

altura.label: Unsafe work at height
altura.instructions: Is someone working at height (ladder, scaffold or shelving) without protection or in an unsafe way?

electrico.label: Electrical hazard
electrico.instructions: Is there an open electrical panel, bare wires or exposed live parts?

carga_inestable.label: Unstable load
carga_inestable.instructions: Are there loads stacked unstably, sticking out or likely to fall?

persona_expuesta.label: Person exposed
persona_expuesta.instructions: Can you see anyone exposed right now to a serious hazard, for example standing on a ladder without protection or handling an open electrical panel?

gravedad.label: Severity
gravedad.instructions: Which level of the company's severity matrix applies to this photo?

levels.label: No risk
levels.description: Facility in normal use and in order: walkways and exits clear, emergency equipment accessible and loads properly placed. Full, properly loaded shelving is not a hazard.

levels.label: Minor
levels.description: Untidiness or a minor breach that would at most cause a minor injury; for example, cables or a power strip on an office floor.

levels.label: Serious
levels.description: Could cause a significant injury or hinder the response to an emergency; for example, an unsigned wet floor, a covered extinguisher or badly stacked boxes that could fall.

levels.label: Critical
levels.description: Imminent danger of very serious injury, electrocution, a fall from height or being unable to evacuate; for example, a blocked emergency exit, an open electrical panel or someone working at height without protection.

notes.reto: Safety rounds produce hundreds of photos that nobody reviews in time: a blocked exit or a covered extinguisher can go unfixed for days, and each manual review takes **about 3 minutes**.
notes.solucion: Each photo is assessed in a single call: **seven yes/no hazards**, whether **anyone is exposed** and the **severity** on an ordered scale. The model does not choose the action: it comes from the **company's risk matrix**, which also sets minimums (a blocked exit is always critical).
notes.paradigma: Any employee with a phone becomes an inspector. There is no need to train a custom vision model: hazards are described in natural language and changed by editing a sentence.
capacidades: ✅ Eight yes/no questions in one call
